headline: Archipelago 1.0.0 brings Ratchet & Clank to multiworld play
summary: Archipelago v1.0.0 is released, letting Ratchet & Clank join an Archipelago multiworld with defeating Drek as the completion goal (#5). Its APWorld package was built and tested against Archipelago 0.6.8, and a follow-up fixes release uploads that omitted the package (#6). Lock-strafe v1.0.3 also releases, restoring L2 and R2 hoverboard tricks by disabling strafing while Ratchet is on the board (#4).
highlights: A signed mod index, submission forms and bot, and a picture pipeline land in #7. The index is published as a pre-release listing, rather than a mod release.
The repository’s references now use openrac-mods (#19). Submission, review and related jobs now act through the organization’s openrac-bot GitHub App (#20).
